title: Profile: Studio
summary: DJDL's Studio profile, the destination of Open Studio profile: the values Studio devices get, where locks (Read-only, Hidden) are set, one unsaved change that makes run.concurrency Read-only, the profile's place in the five-step chain, and who it reaches.
compare: Profiles lists Default first, labelled "Applies to everyone", then one profile per tier that has one; a tier without its own profile (Standard) is explained under the list with Give Standard a profile. Licenses never list profiles.
A profile holds settings and secrets only; entitlements live on the tier, and the card foot says so.

Each value row: key and label, the value, In the app (Editable, Read-only, Hidden) as one select with its glyph, and remove. Secrets show Configured or Not set, Never listed, and Replace…, never a value.

A changed row is tinted with the draft marker and a note under it says what changed and its effect from the U-29 read ("Read-only blocks 1 license's own value (3)"), matching config.effective's blocked-override case.
Where it sits shows the five steps with this profile as step 3; Used by gives Studio licenses (38), devices (104) and the overrides its locks block, from the same read as each license's Config tab.
Header: "1 unsaved change" as a neutral pill, Preview as… (license, tier or person), Discard and Save profile.
Phone: the profile list becomes a switcher, each value row becomes a block (key, then value, In the app and remove on one line), and the rail follows.
